title: Incomplete Priority Rotation for 3 Masters (Using Bitwise NOT)
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [FAIRNESS] Master 2 never granted; last_gnt oscillates 0↔1 only
rtl:
always_ff @(posedge clk)
  if (gnt_done) last_gnt <= ~last_gnt;  // Works for 2 masters only
expected_root_cause: The pointer uses bitwise NOT (~last_gnt) as an increment, which oscillates correctly between 0 and 1 for two masters but never reaches index 2 in a 3-master design because ~2'b10 = 2'b01, not 2'b11.
description: Bitwise NOT on a 2-bit pointer only works for 2 masters (0↔1); with 3 masters it skips master 2 because ~2'b10 = 2'b01 rather than 2'b10 → 2'b00.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [FAIRNESS] Master 2 never granted; last_gnt oscillates 0↔1 only
success_log: last_gnt cycles 0→1→2→0 correctly. All 3 masters granted in sequence.
